name: Fall Guy [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You play the part of a bumbling fool, making your allies look good in comparison.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank.

Benefit(s): You can spend a standard action bumbling around, uttering gaffes, or otherwise making yourself appear to be socially inept. You take a –2 penalty on future Charisma-based checks against characters who witnessed your behavior, but your allies gain a +2 competence bonus on such checks. The penalty and bonus both end after 24 hours.
